reason: The cited evidence (E1–E3) supports near-isotropic RT elasticity and weak temperature-dependent anisotropy in a related alloy (NbTaTiV), but does not directly address HfNbTaTiZr, a yield strength plateau, or the role of short-range ordering. E4 only describes alloy design and does not provide evidence for ordering or dislocation mechanisms. Thus, most key premises lack direct support.
premises: HfNbTaTiZr exhibits nearly isotropic elasticity at room temperature
Elastic anisotropy increases only weakly with temperature in this alloy class
